spec_match.rationale: Reads the exact attributes the feature regates (encodedBodySize, decodedBodySize, transferSize) off real same-origin PerformanceResourceTiming entries, with the spec's semantics (compression, ~300B header allowance, zero-transfer cache signal) explained against live numbers.

interactive.rationale: Asset and cache-mode selects plus a fetch button drive real fetches; byte cards, compression bar and derived readings rebuild from the live entry each run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises PerformanceObserver-delivered entries with compression/cache/overhead derivations; delivered, including the observer-vs-getEntries provenance line.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles fetch failure (real error, assert on the branch), missing entry timeout, uncompressed responses (the local dev server case, honestly labelled), empty bodies, and cache-mode differences.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5195340595724288 and the Resource Timing spec.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite's same-origin assertion mirrors this page's contract and passes on 141; the cross-origin discriminator assertions fail honestly there, as designed.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: reload fetch of styles.css reported decoded 28,381 / encoded 28,381 / transfer 28,681 (uncompressed local server honestly labelled, +300B overhead shown), repeat with cache mode default exercised, observer=true, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow both classes; same-origin behavior is identical pre/post-158 so this page's full contract IS observable on 141.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts same-origin sizes exposed on every run plus distinct fetch-failed and entry-missing branches.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; byte cards charcoal-on-paper; the compression bar is accent-blue on stone with its value also in text.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects, native button, the bar carries role=img with an aria-described value, derived readings are plain text, single polite output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Byte cards auto-fit to one column at 360px; harness ok/ok with no overflow and clean console.

openQuestions.title: Show a real compression ratio on the deployed origin
openQuestions.detail: The local dev server serves styles.css uncompressed, so encoded equals decoded in this evidence. On the Deno Deploy production origin (which content-encodes), confirm the compression bar and transfer-minus-encoded overhead read correctly with a genuine gzip/brotli response.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive stat card row without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) grids collapse without media queries; keep values wrappable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Byte cards use exactly that pattern (11rem basis) with overflow-wrap on values; verified single column at 360px, 0px overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single polite region per surface announcing meaningful completion, not interstitial churn.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One polite output announces fetch completion with the three byte counts; the visual bar's value is mirrored in text for non-visual users.

summary: Same-origin baseline for the regated byte counts: real fetches, observer-delivered entries, compression/cache/overhead derivations from live numbers. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container): clean console/network, ok/ok responsive matrix; same-origin semantics are regime-independent so the full contract was observable.
